regulators.name: FINRA (Federal — Securities)
regulators.summary: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority — federal securities regulator. Applies to ABC's registered-product distribution via broker-dealer.

requirements.title: Customer-specific suitability determination for securities recommendations
requirements.requirement: Before making any securities or strategy recommendation to a specific customer, the firm must assess and document that the recommendation is suitable for that individual customer based on their investment profile (risk tolerance, financial situation, investment objectives, time horizon, liquidity needs). Pass condition: a per-customer suitability record exists and is retained for every recommendation made.

requirements.title: Deferred Variable Annuity Exchange Surveillance Program
requirements.requirement: The member must implement and maintain a supervisory surveillance program specifically designed to detect, review, and document potentially unsuitable deferred variable annuity exchanges (1035 exchanges and internal replacements). The obligation is met when the program produces documented surveillance reviews with disposition records for all identified exchange activity on a continuous basis.

requirements.title: Deferred Variable Annuity Pre-Sale Disclosure Package
requirements.requirement: At or before the time of each deferred variable annuity transaction, the member must provide the customer with clear written disclosure of all surrender charges, fees, tax implications, and material risks associated with the product. The obligation is met when documented disclosure is delivered and acknowledged by the customer prior to or at the point of sale.

requirements.title: Deferred Variable Annuity Representative Training Program
requirements.requirement: The member must establish and maintain a formal training program ensuring that all registered representatives who recommend deferred variable annuities are trained on the product's features, risks, suitability standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. The obligation is met when training completion records exist for all in-scope representatives and the curriculum is reviewed and updated at least annually.

requirements.title: Designated supervisory principals assignment
requirements.requirement: The firm must designate qualified registered principals responsible for supervising each type of business activity in which the firm engages. Pass condition: every material business activity has a named, appropriately registered principal of record with documented supervisory accountability.

requirements.title: FINRA filing of retail communications
requirements.requirement: Certain categories of retail communications must be filed with FINRA (within prescribed timelines, e.g., within 10 business days of first use, or pre-use for new members). Pass condition: all required retail communications are filed with FINRA on time and an evidenced filing log is maintained.

requirements.title: Fair, balanced and non-misleading communications standard
requirements.requirement: All public communications (retail, correspondence, and institutional) must be fair, balanced, and not misleading in content, including accurate representations of risks and benefits. Pass condition: periodic review confirms no communications contain false, exaggerated, or omitted material information that could mislead a recipient.

requirements.title: Member-as-Principal-Underwriter Requirements for Variable Contracts
requirements.requirement: Where the member acts as principal underwriter for variable contracts of an insurance company, it must satisfy all FINRA Rule 2320 requirements applicable to that capacity, including maintenance of required agreements, disclosures, and supervisory controls. Pass condition: written agreements in place, supervisory procedures documented, and annual review evidencing compliance with principal-underwriter obligations.

requirements.title: Principal Review & Approval of Deferred Variable Annuity Applications Within 7 Business Days
requirements.requirement: A registered principal must review and either approve or reject each completed deferred variable annuity application within 7 business days of receipt. The obligation is met when a documented principal sign-off timestamp is recorded within the 7-business-day window for every application submitted.

requirements.title: Principal pre-approval of retail communications
requirements.requirement: A registered principal must review and approve each retail communication before first use or filing. Pass condition: documented approval records exist for every retail communication prior to its dissemination, signed or logged by an eligible principal.

requirements.title: Quantitative suitability review for recommended series of transactions
requirements.requirement: The firm must monitor and review recommended series or patterns of transactions for a customer account to ensure the aggregate activity is not excessive (churning/over-trading) relative to the customer's investment profile. Pass condition: periodic quantitative review reports are produced identifying accounts where recommended transaction volume or turnover may be unsuitable, with escalation records where triggered.

requirements.title: Reasonable-basis suitability analysis for recommended securities/strategies
requirements.requirement: The firm must conduct and document a reasonable-basis suitability analysis establishing that a recommended security or investment strategy has a plausible basis for suitability for at least some investors, based on adequate due diligence. Pass condition: documented product/strategy-level due diligence exists prior to any recommendation being made to customers.

requirements.title: Review of associated persons' business activities
requirements.requirement: Designated principals must conduct and document regular reviews of the business activities of each associated person under their supervision to detect and prevent regulatory violations. Pass condition: evidence of periodic documented review (e.g., trade reviews, activity logs) exists for each supervised person.

requirements.title: Review of associated persons' communications
requirements.requirement: The firm must review correspondence and communications (written, electronic, and social media) of associated persons in accordance with the WSPs to ensure compliance with applicable rules. Pass condition: a documented communications review process exists with records of reviews performed and supervisory sign-offs.

requirements.title: Securities-distribution applicability gate — registered products
requirements.requirement: The insurer must formally document and maintain a written determination identifying which products (variable annuities, variable life, RILAs, mutual funds, 529s) are distributed through an affiliated or third-party broker-dealer and therefore subject to FINRA, SEC, and MSRB requirements, while explicitly excluding fixed annuities and traditional life from that perimeter. Pass condition: a current, approved applicability matrix or scope document exists, is reviewed at least annually (and upon any product launch or distribution-channel change), and is accessible to compliance, legal, and product teams.

requirements.title: Supervisory review & handling of customer complaints
requirements.requirement: The firm must implement a supervisory process for the receipt, review, and resolution of customer complaints, including escalation to a registered principal. Pass condition: all complaints are logged, reviewed by a designated principal, and addressed in accordance with WSPs, with documented disposition records.

requirements.title: Supervisory system design & implementation
requirements.requirement: The firm must establish and maintain a supervisory system — including defined reporting lines, supervisory assignments, and controls — reasonably designed to ensure associated persons comply with applicable securities laws and FINRA rules. Pass condition: a documented supervisory system exists with clear role assignments and operational controls evidencing active supervision.

requirements.title: Variable Contract Payment Receipt & Transmittal Obligation
requirements.requirement: The member firm must promptly receive and transmit all customer payments for variable contracts to the issuing insurance company in accordance with FINRA Rule 2320. Pass condition: documented evidence of timely transmittal (within required timeframes) for each payment received, with no un-transmitted funds held beyond the permitted period.

requirements.title: Variable Contract Sales-Charge Limits Compliance
requirements.requirement: The member firm must ensure that sales charges imposed on variable contract sales do not exceed the maximum permissible limits prescribed by FINRA Rule 2320. Pass condition: all sales-charge schedules and actual charges collected are reviewed and confirmed to be at or below the regulatory cap on a per-contract and aggregate basis.

requirements.title: Written Supervisory Procedures (WSPs) establishment & maintenance
requirements.requirement: The firm must establish, maintain, and enforce written supervisory procedures (WSPs) that are reasonably designed to achieve compliance with applicable securities laws and FINRA rules. Pass condition: WSPs are documented, current, accessible to relevant personnel, and cover all required business activities.

regulators.name: MSRB (Federal — Municipal Securities)
regulators.summary: Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board — federal securities regulator. Applies to ABC's registered-product distribution via broker-dealer.

requirements.title: 529 Plan Advertising & Sales Literature Review (MSRB G-21)
requirements.requirement: All advertisements, sales literature, and promotional materials related to 529 municipal fund securities must be reviewed and approved by a qualified principal before use to ensure they are fair, balanced, and not misleading, in compliance with MSRB Rule G-21. Pass condition: no 529 advertising or sales material is distributed without documented principal pre-approval and retention of the approval record.

requirements.title: 529 Plan Distribution Supervision Program (MSRB G-27)
requirements.requirement: The insurer must establish, maintain, and enforce a written supervisory system (WSPs) specifically covering 529 plan distribution activities, including designated supervisory principals, review procedures for transactions and correspondence, and periodic compliance testing. Pass condition: written supervisory procedures are current, supervisory principals are designated, and evidence of ongoing supervisory reviews is documented.

requirements.title: 529 Plan Fair-Dealing Standard (MSRB G-17)
requirements.requirement: All personnel and agents involved in 529 plan distribution must deal fairly with customers and not engage in deceptive, dishonest, or unfair practices in connection with any 529 transaction or communication. Pass condition: no substantiated G-17 violations; fair-dealing obligations are embedded in training and monitored through periodic review.

requirements.title: 529 Plan Suitability & Best-Interest Obligation (MSRB G-19)
requirements.requirement: The insurer's distribution personnel must perform and document a suitability/best-interest analysis before recommending any 529 municipal fund security to a customer, confirming the recommendation is appropriate for that customer's financial profile, investment objectives, and risk tolerance. Pass condition: every 529 recommendation has a documented suitability rationale on file prior to the transaction.

regulators.name: SEC (Federal — Securities)
regulators.summary: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — federal securities regulator. Applies to ABC's registered-product distribution via broker-dealer.

requirements.title: Reg BI Care Obligation – Best-Interest Suitability Standard for Retail Recommendations
requirements.requirement: The broker-dealer must exercise reasonable diligence, care, and skill to understand each retail customer's investment profile and ensure every recommendation is in that customer's best interest at the time it is made. Pass condition: documented rationale for each recommendation demonstrates consideration of costs, risks, and alternatives relative to the individual retail customer's profile.

requirements.title: Reg BI Compliance Obligation – Written Policies and Procedures Program
requirements.requirement: The broker-dealer must establish, maintain, and enforce written policies and procedures reasonably designed to achieve compliance with all four Reg BI component obligations (Disclosure, Care, Conflict-of-Interest, and Compliance itself), subject to FINRA examination. Pass condition: a current, Board-approved Reg BI compliance program exists with evidence of periodic testing, remediation tracking, and FINRA examination readiness.

requirements.title: Reg BI Conflict-of-Interest Obligation – Conflict Identification and Mitigation Program
requirements.requirement: The broker-dealer must establish, maintain, and enforce written policies and procedures to identify all conflicts of interest associated with retail recommendations and either eliminate or mitigate those conflicts so they do not place the firm's interest ahead of the retail customer's interest. Pass condition: a conflict inventory is maintained, annually reviewed, and conflicts are demonstrably mitigated or eliminated per written procedures.

requirements.title: Reg BI Disclosure Obligation – Form CRS & Pre-Recommendation Disclosure
requirements.requirement: The broker-dealer must deliver a Form CRS relationship summary and disclose material facts about the recommendation (including fees, conflicts, and the capacity in which it acts) to retail customers before or at the time of a recommendation. Pass condition: documented pre-recommendation disclosures are on file for every retail customer interaction involving a recommendation, and Form CRS is current and timely delivered.
